name: flowww-operations
description: Lambda that will authenticate and change to the correct center to handle requests in flowww

scripts.publish: rm -rf node_modules package-lock.json && npm install --production && zip -r flowww-operations.zip . && aws s3 cp flowww-operations.zip s3://flowww-operations-bucket-2/flowww-operations.zip --profile personal --region eu-west-3 && aws lambda update-function-code --profile personal --region eu-west-3 --function-name flowww-operations --s3-bucket flowww-operations-bucket-2 --s3-key flowww-operations.zip
